name: level-editor
description: In-game level editor: an Edit run mode over the real pipeline (scaffold — editor systems land in later waves)
postInstallNotes:
## level-editor module installed (scaffold)

This module is a **skeleton** today. Wave 1 ships only the contract that the editor stands on:

- the run-state model in `foundation` (`GameState.RunMode` Play/Edit + `EditTimeBehavior` + the `GatedSystem` decorator), and
- the docs codifying "the editor is part of the game" (`docs/CORE_TENETS.md` tenet + a `foundation` run-state premise).

The editor's own components and systems (scene-object tagging + serializer registry, `LoadSceneRequest` reader/writer, `SelectedComponent` + selection, the transform gizmo, bounded undo/redo, and the engine-native toolbar) arrive in later waves (3–5). See `docs/level-editor/roadmap.md` (added in Wave 2) for the wave map and plug-in points.

To opt a screen into editing: wrap the game-logic / physics / camera-follow systems in `GatedSystem(child, EditTimeBehavior.Freeze)` and keep render / input / cursor / `HierarchySystem` ungated (or `RunNormally`), then flip `gameState.RunMode` to enter/exit Edit without a screen swap. The full system-by-mode policy is the interaction matrix in `docs/CORE_TENETS.md`.
